pkgmetadata.longdescription: Chrome for Testing is the Chrome flavour Google publishes for browser automation: versioned, without auto-update, and the build Playwright and Puppeteer download by default. Installed system-wide in /opt/chrome-for-testing so automation tools can share one browser (for the Playwright MCP server, PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/opt/chrome-for-testing/chrome).
